Hi Tom + Priya 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discovery, I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones, proposed owners, and dependencies we discussed. High level:

- Target: production pilot by mid-May (we can lock exact date once owners confirm)
- Key milestones: SOW & contract -> Security questionnaire & review -> Pilot deployment -> Production rolloff
- Redwood owners are suggested on the right column (Sales/Eng/CS)  please confirm or update.

Ask: Could you confirm the internal stakeholders for these roles so we can finalize the MAP and propose a target close date? Specifically we need confirmation for:
- Economic buyer
- Security owner / reviewer
- Legal owner for contract signatures
- Engineering lead for integration and pilot
Attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (first pass)
Also attaching the standard SOW template for visibility.

Next steps from our side once you confirm: update MAP, lock milestones, and prepare a short pilot SOW for sign-off.

Thanks

Hi Tom + Priya 

Thanks for the quick responses. I've incorporated the stakeholder roles you provided and attached MAP-draft-v2.xlsx with the following confirmed items: 

Milestones & target dates (proposed)
- SOW & commercial terms agreed: 2026-03-26 (owner: Priya / Ben)
- Security questionnaire + docs review: 2026-04-02 (owner: Rajiv Mehta / Redwood security team)
- Pilot deployment & integration: 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-05 (owner: James Li / Marcus Lin)
- Pilot review & success criteria sign-off: 2026-05-10 (joint owners)
- Target production roll: 2026-05-15 (final go/no-go)

Proposed RACI (summary)
- Economic buyer: Tom Jenkins (Acuity)  Accountable
- Legal owner: Priya Shah (Acuity)  Responsible for contract review & approval
- Security owner: Rajiv Mehta (Acuity)  Responsible for security review
- Engineering lead: James Li (Acuity)  Responsible for integration; Marcus Lin (Redwood)  Responsible for Redwood side of integration

Dependencies & notes
- We need Acuity's SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence for the security review. If that's delayed we'll push the pilot start by ~2 weeks.
- Legal wants the SOW + DPA language; Ben will loop in legal if there are any redlines.

Ask: Please confirm the RACI above and the target production date of 2026-05-15. If that works, I'll circulate an updated MAP + short SOW addendum for signature.

Thanks
